title: 【RPG Design Guides】How to Convey Information in a Scenario

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】シナリオにおける情報の伝え方
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】How to Convey Information in a Scenario

blocks.source: シナリオを進行させるため、制作者はプレイヤーに対して、様々な情報を与える必要がある。また、物語の厚みを増すために、ゲーム進行に必要がない情報でも色々と盛り込んでいきたい所だろう。
blocks.translation: To move the scenario forward, the creator needs to provide the player with various kinds of information. To add depth to the story, you will also likely want to include all sorts of information that is not essential to progressing through the game.

blocks.source: そこで、それら情報をプレイヤーに伝える方法を考える。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, let us consider ways to convey this information to the player.

blocks.source: 情報を元にセリフを作成する。
blocks.translation: Create dialogue based on the information.

blocks.source: 例えば、プレイヤーに対して、以下のような情報を与えたいとする。
blocks.translation: For example, suppose we want to give the player the following information.

blocks.source: ①主人公は勇者。王様の命令を受けて魔王を倒すことが目的。
blocks.translation: ① The protagonist is the Luminary. Their goal is to defeat the Demon Lord at the king’s command.

blocks.source: ②魔王は世界を支配しようとしている。
blocks.translation: ② The Demon Lord is trying to take over the world.

blocks.source: ③実は魔王は王様の弟で、善良な人間だったが、なんか色々あって魔王になった。
blocks.translation: ③ The Demon Lord is actually the king’s younger brother. He was a good person, but became the Demon Lord after various unfortunate events.

blocks.source: ④魔王は『北の洞窟』を抜けた先の『雪の町』から、さらに『東の山』を越えた先の『魔王城』にいる。
blocks.translation: ④ The Demon Lord is in the Demon Lord’s Castle, beyond the Eastern Mountain, which lies beyond the Snow Town reached by passing through the Northern Cave.

blocks.source: ⑤魔王を倒すには『伝説の剣』が必要である。
blocks.translation: ⑤ The Legendary Sword is needed to defeat the Demon Lord.

blocks.source: ⑥伝説の剣は『西の神殿』にある。
blocks.translation: ⑥ The Legendary Sword is in the Western Temple.

blocks.source: ⑦伝説の剣は５００年前の英雄が使用していた剣である。
blocks.translation: ⑦ The Legendary Sword was used by a hero 500 years ago.

blocks.source: ⑧１００Ｇを渡す。城下町に装備が売っているので、そこで準備をすべき。
blocks.translation: ⑧ Give the player 100 G. Equipment is sold in the castle town, so they should prepare there.

blocks.source: 以上を前提に、各情報を王様が主人公である勇者に伝える形式でセリフを考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: Based on the above, let us create dialogue in which the king conveys each piece of information to the protagonist, the Luminary.

blocks.source: 王様
blocks.translation: King

blocks.source: 「よくぞ来た。勇者ＸＸＸＸよ。
blocks.translation: “You have finally arrived, Luminary XXXX.

blocks.source: 今日 お前を呼び出したのは 他でもない。
blocks.translation: I summoned you today for one reason.

blocks.source: 魔王が世界を支配しようとしているのだ」
blocks.translation: The Demon Lord is trying to take over the world.”

blocks.source: 「魔王は実は私の弟で 善良な男だったのだが
blocks.translation: “The Demon Lord is actually my younger brother. He was a good man,

blocks.source: 哀れにも ブサメンだったのだ」
blocks.translation: but sadly, he was ugly.”

blocks.source: 「モテなくて 絶望に打ちひしがれていた所を
blocks.translation: “He could not attract anyone and was crushed by despair

blocks.source: 暗黒の力に魅入られてしまったのだ」
blocks.translation: when he was seduced by the power of darkness.”

blocks.source: 「頼む 勇者よ。弟……いや魔王を倒し
blocks.translation: “Please, Luminary. Defeat my brother… no, the Demon Lord,

blocks.source: この世界を救ってくれ！」
blocks.translation: and save this world!”

blocks.source: 「魔王は『北の洞窟』を抜けた先の『雪の町』から
blocks.translation: “The Demon Lord is in the Demon Lord’s Castle, beyond the Snow Town reached by passing through the Northern Cave,

blocks.source: さらに『東の山』を越えた先の『魔王城』にいる」
blocks.translation: and then crossing the Eastern Mountain.”

blocks.source: 「だが 魔王は強敵。いくらお前が勇敢でも
blocks.translation: “However, the Demon Lord is a formidable foe. No matter how brave you are,

blocks.source: 安々と勝てる相手ではないだろう。
blocks.translation: he is not someone you can defeat easily.

blocks.source: そこで 西の神殿にある『伝説の剣』を手にするのだ」
blocks.translation: That is why you must obtain the Legendary Sword in the Western Temple.”

blocks.source: 「伝説の剣とは かつて５００年前の英雄○○○○が
blocks.translation: “The Legendary Sword is the sword that the hero XXXX used 500 years ago

blocks.source: 当時の魔王を倒す際に用いた剣だ。
blocks.translation: to defeat the Demon Lord of that era.

blocks.source: 必ずや お前の力となるだろう」
blocks.translation: It will surely lend you its power.”

blocks.source: 「旅立つに当たって 資金を与えよう。
blocks.translation: “I shall give you funds for your journey.

blocks.source: 城下町で 装備を整えるが良い」
blocks.translation: You would do well to prepare your equipment in the castle town.”

blocks.source: ＞１００Ｇを手に入れた。
blocks.translation: > Obtained 100 G.

blocks.source: 「では 行け！ 勇者ＸＸＸＸよ！」
blocks.translation: “Now, go! Luminary XXXX!”

blocks.source: 必要な情報に絞る。
blocks.translation: Narrow it down to the necessary information.

blocks.source: これで情報を余さず伝えられた。
blocks.translation: This conveys all the information without leaving anything out.

blocks.source: ……がしかし、これでは情報が多すぎてプレイヤーが混乱してしまう。
blocks.translation: …However, there is so much information that the player will become confused.

blocks.source: これは雑にセリフを書いた例であって、実際はストーリー性を付け足すために、もっと冗長な文章になるはず。このままではまずいので、ここは情報を分割するべきだろう。
blocks.translation: This is just a rough example of dialogue; in practice, the text would be even more verbose to add a sense of story. It would be problematic to leave it like this, so we should divide the information here.

blocks.source: まずは、この時点で本当に必要な情報が何であるか整理してみよう。
blocks.translation: First, let us organize what information is truly necessary at this point.

blocks.source: ①主人公は勇者。王様の命令を受けて魔王を倒すことが目的。
blocks.translation: ① The protagonist is the Luminary. Their goal is to defeat the Demon Lord at the king’s command.

blocks.source: は物語の大きな目的なので、これが無いと始まらない。
blocks.translation: This is the story’s overarching objective, so the story cannot begin without it.

blocks.source: ②魔王は世界を支配しようとしている。
blocks.translation: ② The Demon Lord is trying to take over the world.

blocks.source: もついでに付けておいた方が良いだろう。無害な魔王なら倒す必要も無いわけで、悪い魔王を倒すという動機付けのためには必要となる。
blocks.translation: It would also be good to include this. If the Demon Lord were harmless, there would be no need to defeat him, so this is necessary to motivate the player to defeat an evil Demon Lord.

blocks.source: ⑤魔王を倒すには『伝説の剣』が必要である。
blocks.translation: ⑤ The Legendary Sword is needed to defeat the Demon Lord.

blocks.source: ⑥伝説の剣は『西の神殿』にある。
blocks.translation: ⑥ The Legendary Sword is in the Western Temple.

blocks.source: は物語の当面の目的となる部分。これがないと次にどこに行けば良いのか分からないので、当然必要となる。
blocks.translation: These form the story’s immediate objective. Without them, the player would not know where to go next, so they are naturally necessary.

blocks.source: ⑧１００Ｇを渡す。城下町に装備が売っているので、そこで準備をすべき。
blocks.translation: ⑧ Give the player 100 G. Equipment is sold in the castle town, so they should prepare there.

blocks.source: はゲームシステム上、プレイヤーを補佐するために必要となる。
blocks.translation: From a game-system perspective, this is necessary to support the player.

blocks.source: 必要な情報はこの位か。セリフを再構成してみよう。
blocks.translation: That should be all the necessary information. Let's reconstruct the dialogue.

blocks.source: 王様
blocks.translation: King

blocks.source: 「よくぞ来た。勇者ＸＸＸＸよ。
blocks.translation: “Welcome, Luminary XXXX.

blocks.source: 今日 お前を呼び出したのは 他でもない。
blocks.translation: I summoned you today for one reason.

blocks.source: 魔王が世界を支配しようとしているのだ」
blocks.translation: The Demon King is attempting to conquer the world.”

blocks.source: 「頼む 勇者よ。奴を倒し
blocks.translation: “Please, Luminary. Defeat him

blocks.source: この世界を救ってくれ！」
blocks.translation: and save this world!”

blocks.source: 「だが 魔王は強敵。いくらお前が勇敢でも
blocks.translation: “But the Demon King is a formidable foe. No matter how brave you are,

blocks.source: 安々と勝てる相手ではないだろう。
blocks.translation: he is not an opponent you can defeat easily.

blocks.source: そこで 西の神殿にある『伝説の剣』を手にするのだ」
blocks.translation: So take the Legendary Sword from the temple in the west.”

blocks.source: 「旅立つに当たって 資金を与えよう。
blocks.translation: “I will give you some funds for your journey.

blocks.source: 城下町で 装備を整えるが良い」
blocks.translation: You should purchase your equipment in the castle town.”

blocks.source: ＞１００Ｇを手に入れた。
blocks.translation: >You obtained 100G.

blocks.source: 「では 行け！ 勇者ＸＸＸＸよ！」
blocks.translation: “Now go! Luminary XXXX!”

blocks.source: これで随分とすっきりした。これならば、ストーリー性を付加するために、セリフを増やしたとしても、そこまで冗長な文章にはならずに済むはず。
blocks.translation: This is much more concise. With this version, even if I add more dialogue to enhance the story, it shouldn't become excessively wordy.

blocks.source: ⑦伝説の剣は５００年前の英雄が使用していた剣である。
blocks.translation: ⑦The Legendary Sword was used by a hero 500 years ago.

blocks.source: は残したままでもよいかと思うが、その辺はお好みで。以降の例では⑦は削った物として扱う。
blocks.translation: I think you could leave this in, but that's up to you. In the examples that follow, I will treat ⑦ as having been removed.

blocks.source: 情報を分割する。
blocks.translation: Divide the Information.

blocks.source: 次に、上記で不要とした情報を見てみよう。これらの役割は以下のように説明できる。
blocks.translation: Next, let's look at the information deemed unnecessary above. Its roles can be explained as follows.

blocks.source: ③実は魔王は王様の弟で、善良な人間だったが、なんか色々あって魔王になった。
blocks.translation: ③The Demon King is actually the younger brother of the king. He was a good person, but became the Demon King after various events.

blocks.source: 魔王について、物語的に補強する材料。
blocks.translation: Material that provides story-based background about the Demon King.

blocks.source: ④魔王は『北の洞窟』を抜けた先の『雪の町』から、さらに『東の山』を越えた先の『魔王城』にいる。
blocks.translation: ④The Demon King is in the Demon King's Castle, beyond the Eastern Mountains, which lie beyond the Snow Town reached by passing through the Northern Cave.

blocks.source: 魔王の居場所。今は必要ではないが、後のゲーム進行に必須となる。
blocks.translation: The Demon King's whereabouts. It isn't necessary at this point, but will be essential to the game's later progression.

blocks.source: ⑦伝説の剣は５００年前の英雄が使用していた剣である。
blocks.translation: ⑦The Legendary Sword was used by a hero 500 years ago.

blocks.source: 伝説の剣について、物語的に補強する材料。
blocks.translation: Material that provides story-based background about the Legendary Sword.

blocks.source: ③⑦については、ゲーム進行上は必ずしも必要な情報ではない。ただし、このような情報を付け足すことで物語に対して深みを出すことができる。
blocks.translation: Information ③ and ⑦ are not necessarily required for game progression. However, adding information like this can give the story greater depth.

blocks.source: それでは、これら３つの情報をどのようにして、プレイヤーに伝えるかだ。
blocks.translation: Now, how should we convey these three pieces of information to the player?

blocks.source: ④については、主人公が伝説の剣を持ち帰った際のイベントで改めて説明するようにしよう。④はそれ自体、地名が４つも登場する複雑な情報なので、伝え方を考えてみる。
blocks.translation: As for ④, let's explain it again in the event that occurs when the protagonist returns with the Legendary Sword. Since ④ is complicated information that includes no fewer than four place names, let's consider how to present it.

blocks.source: 王様
blocks.translation: King

blocks.source: 「伝説の剣を持って帰るとは さすがは勇者だ！
blocks.translation: “You actually brought back the Legendary Sword. As expected of the Luminary!

blocks.source: いよいよ 魔王との対決が近付いて来たのだな」
blocks.translation: At last, the confrontation with the Demon King is drawing near.”

blocks.source: 「魔王はここより遥か北東の『魔王城』にいる。
blocks.translation: “The Demon King is in the Demon King's Castle, far to the northeast of here.

blocks.source: たどり着くには『北の洞窟』と『東の山』を通らねばならぬ。
blocks.translation: To reach it, you must pass through the Northern Cave and the Eastern Mountains.

blocks.source: 言うまでもなく 険しい道のりとなるだろう」
blocks.translation: Needless to say, it will be a perilous journey.”

blocks.source: 「まずは 『北の洞窟』を抜けた先にある
blocks.translation: “First, you should head for

blocks.source: 『雪の町』を目指すが良い」
blocks.translation: the Snow Town beyond the Northern Cave.”

blocks.source: 最後の「」で当面の目的である『北の洞窟』と『雪の町』を強調する所がポイント。ちなみに、ここでは『東の山』についての情報はあえて省略しても良い。その情報は『雪の町』の住民に語らせれば良いだろう。
blocks.translation: The key point is to emphasize the Northern Cave and the Snow Town, your immediate destinations, in the final line of dialogue. Incidentally, you could deliberately omit the information about the Eastern Mountains here. You could have the residents of the Snow Town tell the player about it instead.

blocks.source: ③実は魔王は王様の弟で、善良な人間だったが、なんか色々あって魔王になった。
blocks.translation: ③The Demon King is actually the younger brother of the king. He was a good person, but became the Demon King after various events.

blocks.source: ⑦伝説の剣は５００年前の英雄が使用していた剣である。
blocks.translation: ⑦The Legendary Sword was used by a hero 500 years ago.

blocks.source: についても、タイミングを変えてイベントで語らせても良い。例えば、伝説の剣を手に入れて、魔王討伐に向かう主人公が城を出ようとしたタイミングで……
blocks.translation: These could also be revealed in an event at a different point in the story. For example, just as the protagonist, having obtained the Legendary Sword and set out to defeat the Demon King, is about to leave the castle…

blocks.source: 大臣
blocks.translation: Minister

blocks.source: 「お待ちください 勇者殿！
blocks.translation: “Wait, Luminary!

blocks.source: 王様は 何もおっしゃいませんでしたが
blocks.translation: The king never mentioned this,

blocks.source: 実は魔王の正体は……
blocks.translation: but the Demon King's true identity is…

blocks.source: （以下、回想シーン）
blocks.translation: (The following is a flashback scene)

blocks.source: ……のようにしてみる。こうすれば、最初の王との会話で一気に説明されるよりも、よほど印象が深まるだろう。特に重要度が高い情報については、このようにして強調したい。
blocks.translation: You could do it like this. This would make a much stronger impression than explaining everything at once during the initial conversation with the king. This is how you should emphasize particularly important information.

blocks.source: また、魔王の正体に関して、意味深なセリフを事前に入れておけば、伏線となる。プレイヤーに謎を投げかけることで焦らし、先の展開への期待を持たせよう。
blocks.translation: You can also set up a plot point by including a meaningful line about the Demon King's true identity in advance. Tease the player by presenting them with a mystery and build anticipation for what comes next.

blocks.source: 重要度が低い情報ならば、城の住民の会話などに入れてしまってもよいだろう。
blocks.translation: If the information is of low importance, you could simply include it in conversations among the castle's residents.

blocks.source: 兵士
blocks.translation: Soldier

blocks.source: 「伝説の剣とは かつて５００年前の英雄が
blocks.translation: “The Legendary Sword was once used by a hero 500 years ago

blocks.source: 当時の魔王を倒す際に用いた剣です」
blocks.translation: It is the sword used to defeat the Demon King at the time.”

blocks.source: 「その力 余りにも強大であったために
blocks.translation: “Because its power was far too great,

blocks.source: 悪用を恐れた英雄が
blocks.translation: the hero, fearing it would be misused,

blocks.source: 西の神殿に封じたと言われています」
blocks.translation: is said to have sealed it in the western temple.”

blocks.source: 仲間キャラクターがいるならば、そちらに語らせるのも手だ。例えば、伝説の剣がある神殿の入口で、イベントを起こし、剣に関する設定を語らせる。そうすれば、そのキャラクターに対して博識というキャラ付けをすることもできる。
blocks.translation: If you have companion characters, you can have them explain things instead. For example, you could trigger an event at the entrance to the temple where the legendary sword is located and have a companion explain the sword's background. This also lets you characterize that companion as knowledgeable.

blocks.source: 他にも、実はそのキャラクターが英雄の子孫とかいう設定ならば、後に正体を明かす際の伏線にもなる。
blocks.translation: Furthermore, if that character is secretly a descendant of the hero, for example, it can serve as foreshadowing for when their true identity is revealed later.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 言うまでもないけれど、実際にストーリーを制作する場合は、王と主人公の対面のように、１：１の単純な構図ばかりでは済まない。
blocks.translation: Needless to say, when actually creating a story, you cannot rely solely on simple one-on-one setups, such as a meeting between the king and the protagonist.

blocks.source: 特にゲーム序盤は世界設定・人物設定・システム等、プレイヤーに伝えるべき情報であふれている。全てを一気に伝えようとすると、プレイヤーを混乱させかねない。シーンを分割して、少しずつプレイヤーに伝えるようにしていきたい。
blocks.translation: The early stages of a game, in particular, are overflowing with information that needs to be conveyed to the player, including the world setting, character backgrounds, and systems. Trying to convey everything at once may confuse the player. You should divide the scenes and convey the information to the player little by little.

texts.……がしかし、これでは情報が多すぎてプレイヤーが混乱してしまう。: …However, there is so much information that the player will become confused.
texts.これは雑にセリフを書いた例であって、実際はストーリー性を付け足すために、もっと冗: This is just a rough example of dialogue; in practice, the text would be even more verbose to add a sense of story. It would be problematic to leave it like this, so we should divide the information here.
texts.まずは、この時点で本当に必要な情報が何であるか整理してみよう。: First, let us organize what information is truly necessary at this point.
texts.は物語の大きな目的なので、これが無いと始まらない。: This is the story’s overarching objective, so the story cannot begin without it.
texts.もついでに付けておいた方が良いだろう。無害な魔王なら倒す必要も無いわけで、悪い魔: It would also be good to include this. If the Demon Lord were harmless, there would be no need to defeat him, so this is necessary to motivate the player to defeat an evil Demon Lord.
texts.は物語の当面の目的となる部分。これがないと次にどこに行けば良いのか分からないので: These form the story’s immediate objective. Without them, the player would not know where to go next, so they are naturally necessary.
texts.はゲームシステム上、プレイヤーを補佐するために必要となる。: From a game-system perspective, this is necessary to support the player.
texts.必要な情報はこの位か。セリフを再構成してみよう。: That should be all the necessary information. Let's reconstruct the dialogue.
texts.これで随分とすっきりした。これならば、ストーリー性を付加するために、セリフを増や: This is much more concise. With this version, even if I add more dialogue to enhance the story, it shouldn't become excessively wordy.
texts.は残したままでもよいかと思うが、その辺はお好みで。以降の例では⑦は削った物として: I think you could leave this in, but that's up to you. In the examples that follow, I will treat ⑦ as having been removed.
texts.次に、上記で不要とした情報を見てみよう。これらの役割は以下のように説明できる。: Next, let's look at the information deemed unnecessary above. Its roles can be explained as follows.
texts.魔王について、物語的に補強する材料。: Material that provides story-based background about the Demon King.
texts.魔王の居場所。今は必要ではないが、後のゲーム進行に必須となる。: The Demon King's whereabouts. It isn't necessary at this point, but will be essential to the game's later progression.
texts.伝説の剣について、物語的に補強する材料。: Material that provides story-based background about the Legendary Sword.
texts.③⑦については、ゲーム進行上は必ずしも必要な情報ではない。ただし、このような情報: Information ③ and ⑦ are not necessarily required for game progression. However, adding information like this can give the story greater depth.
texts.それでは、これら３つの情報をどのようにして、プレイヤーに伝えるかだ。: Now, how should we convey these three pieces of information to the player?
texts.④については、主人公が伝説の剣を持ち帰った際のイベントで改めて説明するようにしよ: As for ④, let's explain it again in the event that occurs when the protagonist returns with the Legendary Sword. Since ④ is complicated information that includes no fewer than four place names, let's consider how to present it.
texts.「伝説の剣を持って帰るとは さすがは勇者だ！: “You actually brought back the Legendary Sword. As expected of the Luminary!
texts.いよいよ 魔王との対決が近付いて来たのだな」: At last, the confrontation with the Demon King is drawing near.”
texts.「魔王はここより遥か北東の『魔王城』にいる。: “The Demon King is in the Demon King's Castle, far to the northeast of here.
texts.たどり着くには『北の洞窟』と『東の山』を通らねばならぬ。: To reach it, you must pass through the Northern Cave and the Eastern Mountains.
texts.言うまでもなく 険しい道のりとなるだろう」: Needless to say, it will be a perilous journey.”
texts.『雪の町』を目指すが良い」: the Snow Town beyond the Northern Cave.”
texts.最後の「」で当面の目的である『北の洞窟』と『雪の町』を強調する所がポイント。ちな: The key point is to emphasize the Northern Cave and the Snow Town, your immediate destinations, in the final line of dialogue. Incidentally, you could deliberately omit the information about the Eastern Mountains here. You could have the residents of the Snow Town tell the player about it instead.
texts.についても、タイミングを変えてイベントで語らせても良い。例えば、伝説の剣を手に入: These could also be revealed in an event at a different point in the story. For example, just as the protagonist, having obtained the Legendary Sword and set out to defeat the Demon King, is about to leave the castle…
texts.実は魔王の正体は……: but the Demon King's true identity is…
texts.……のようにしてみる。こうすれば、最初の王との会話で一気に説明されるよりも、よほ: You could do it like this. This would make a much stronger impression than explaining everything at once during the initial conversation with the king. This is how you should emphasize particularly important information.
texts.また、魔王の正体に関して、意味深なセリフを事前に入れておけば、伏線となる。プレイ: You can also set up a plot point by including a meaningful line about the Demon King's true identity in advance. Tease the player by presenting them with a mystery and build anticipation for what comes next.
texts.重要度が低い情報ならば、城の住民の会話などに入れてしまってもよいだろう。: If the information is of low importance, you could simply include it in conversations among the castle's residents.
texts.「伝説の剣とは かつて５００年前の英雄が: “The Legendary Sword was once used by a hero 500 years ago
texts.当時の魔王を倒す際に用いた剣です」: It is the sword used to defeat the Demon King at the time.”
texts.「その力 余りにも強大であったために: “Because its power was far too great,
texts.悪用を恐れた英雄が: the hero, fearing it would be misused,
texts.西の神殿に封じたと言われています」: is said to have sealed it in the western temple.”
texts.仲間キャラクターがいるならば、そちらに語らせるのも手だ。例えば、伝説の剣がある神: If you have companion characters, you can have them explain things instead. For example, you could trigger an event at the entrance to the temple where the legendary sword is located and have a companion explain the sword's background. This also lets you characterize that companion as knowledgeable.
texts.他にも、実はそのキャラクターが英雄の子孫とかいう設定ならば、後に正体を明かす際の: Furthermore, if that character is secretly a descendant of the hero, for example, it can serve as foreshadowing for when their true identity is revealed later.
texts.言うまでもないけれど、実際にストーリーを制作する場合は、王と主人公の対面のように: Needless to say, when actually creating a story, you cannot rely solely on simple one-on-one setups, such as a meeting between the king and the protagonist.
texts.特にゲーム序盤は世界設定・人物設定・システム等、プレイヤーに伝えるべき情報であふ: The early stages of a game, in particular, are overflowing with information that needs to be conveyed to the player, including the world setting, character backgrounds, and systems. Trying to convey everything at once may confuse the player. You should divide the scenes and convey the information to the player little by little.
